topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't shake the echoing silence that's settled in the space between us since you told me. Moving across the country, you said, like it’s just another chapter in a book. But it’s not a book; it's real. It's us. I keep trying to piece together what this means, what it will be like without the easy conversations, the unspoken understandings. I feel like I’m trying to hold on to water. I know change is inevitable, a fact you’re embracing with a smile that doesn’t quite reach your eyes. How do I navigate this, when all the maps are blurring in my hands?
